company.name: Vouch
company.shortDescription: Vouch is an insurance company that provides business insurance solutions for high-growth companies through a tech-enabled platform.
company.description: Vouch provides business insurance solutions designed for high-growth companies through a tech-enabled platform. The company offers access to multiple insurance carriers and instant quoting capabilities through its MGA brand, Corix. Its services are structured to help startups and technology-driven businesses manage risk as they scale. Vouch continues to expand its offerings by integrating technology and industry expertise to address emerging risks.
